sub_graphs.description: Models the subscription-based notification flow for completed transactions

nodes.label: No Active Subscription
nodes.description: Client has no active subscription for transaction completions

nodes.label: Create Subscription
nodes.description: Client sends eth_subscribe with 'completedTransaction' parameter

nodes.label: Subscription Active
nodes.description: Subscription is active and node is monitoring for matching transactions

nodes.label: Transaction Sealed in Block
nodes.description: A matching transaction has been included in a block

nodes.label: Push Completion Notification
nodes.description: Node pushes notification with transaction hash and return data to subscriber

nodes.label: Notification Delivered
nodes.description: Client has received the transaction completion notification

nodes.label: Cancel Subscription
nodes.description: Client sends eth_unsubscribe to stop receiving notifications

sub_graphs.title: EIP-758: Chain Reorganization Handling
sub_graphs.description: Models how notifications are resent when chain reorganizations occur

nodes.label: Transaction Notification Sent
nodes.description: A notification for transaction completion has been delivered

nodes.label: Chain Reorganization Detected
nodes.description: A chain reorganization has been detected affecting previously notified transactions

nodes.label: Check if Transaction Affected
nodes.description: Determine if previously notified transaction was removed by reorg

nodes.description: The transaction that was notified is no longer in the canonical chain

nodes.description: Push notification again with 'removed: true' to indicate reversal

nodes.label: Client Notified of Removal
nodes.description: Client has been informed that previously completed transaction was reversed

ambiguities.text: The EIP does not specify error responses or edge-case handling for invalid filter parameters.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard JSON-RPC error responses are returned for invalid parameters (error code -32602 Invalid params).

ambiguities.text: It's unclear what happens if a subscription exists when the underlying WebSocket connection is lost.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume subscriptions are automatically cleaned up when the connection is lost; clients must resubscribe.

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'all transactions sealed after the creation of the filter' does not specify handling of pending transactions at filter creation time.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume only transactions mined in blocks after filter creation are included, excluding those in the pending pool.

implicit_assumptions.description: The node correctly identifies which client submitted which transaction for subscription notifications.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Polling-based filtering cannot verify transaction origin, potentially leaking transaction information to unauthorized clients.

implicit_assumptions.description: WebSocket connections remain stable for the duration of the subscription.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Clients may miss transaction completion notifications during connection disruptions.

implicit_assumptions.description: Clients handle 'removed: true' notifications correctly and update their state accordingly.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Applications could display incorrect transaction status after chain reorganizations.
